title: Spicy Korean Noodle Stir Fry
description: A spicy and savory stir fry made with Korean chili flakes, sauerkraut, and wild noodles.
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add spicy Korean chili flakes and stir for 1 minute.
Add sauerkraut and cook for 3-4 minutes, until slightly caramelized.
Stir in soy sauce and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine.
Top with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds (if using).
